_comment: The eight tools FunctionCallCatalogue selects on a native install (spokenOrder, capped at maxTools=8), plus the parameterless no_action abstention tool that FunctionCallRelevance.wireTools adds. Families group near-synonyms so the report can score exact-id and family accuracy separately: the catalogue deliberately contains synonyms (three email tools, two calendar tools, two document tools) that no fixture can distinguish by id. Descriptions are terse paraphrases of the registry's own; parameter schemas are representative and sized like the app's, which is what drives Needle's per-proposal latency.

abstention.description: Take no action. Ordinary conversation, a question, or a request for something outside this list.

tools.description: Send an email message to someone now.
tools.criteria: Send an email to a recipient with a subject and body.

tools.description: Create a calendar event or diary entry at a specific time.
tools.criteria: Create a calendar event with a title, start and end time.

tools.description: Write a draft email to review before sending.
tools.criteria: Create an unsent email draft with a subject and body.

tools.description: Create a new document with content.
tools.criteria: Create a brand new document given a title and initial content.

tools.description: Add an item to the schedule at a date and time.
tools.criteria: Add a scheduled item or appointment to the diary.

tools.description: Append text to an existing document.
tools.criteria: Add a line of text to a document that already exists.

tools.description: Remember a fact about the user or project for later.
tools.criteria: Store a durable note or preference to recall later.

tools.description: Reply to an existing email message.
tools.criteria: Reply to a received email thread with a body.
